textStyles.name: component/typography/button
textStyles.description: Component-scoped local text style for <Typography> Variant=Button. Resolves the missing material-design/typography/button. Noto Sans TC Medium 14/24, letter-spacing 0%, textCase UPPER (matches MUI runtime text-transform: uppercase). Component-scoped only because the design-system convention zeroes textCase on every material-design/typography/* style.

textStyles.name: component/typography/overline
textStyles.description: Component-scoped local text style for <Typography> Variant=Overline. Mirrors material-design/typography/overline (Noto Sans TC Regular 12/32, ls 0%) but bakes textCase=UPPER directly so the cell can bind to it without losing its textStyleId. Component-scoped only because the design-system convention zeroes textCase on every material-design/typography/* style.

textStyles.name: material-design/typography/h1-bold
textStyles.description: Bold-weight companion of material-design/typography/h1. Local-only (the design-system file does not yet ship bold typography). Used by the Figma <Typography> component set when Bold=On.
